propositions: Operators reaching for --force on 25 FORCE_CLOSE records are closing non-bug tickets (task/story/epic) with administrative dispositions (duplicate, obsolete, wontfix, stale-premise) where no completion work exists, but the vocabulary and type gates limit --class to bugs only, leaving no truthful exit path.
The close-precheck failure message never enumerates the applicable --class values for the ticket type, so operators cannot discover the narrow administrative-disposition path that does exist.

Administrative close classes (duplicate, obsolete, superseded, wontfix) must be discoverable from the close-gate failure message and routable without completion verification, while reason-required classes (obsolete, wontfix) must enforce reason capture and persist it as a distinct close_reason event key.

Non-bug closes with administrative classes require a single-sourced vocabulary extension (ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES, REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES), write-side guard in transition_core, precheck skip for verification, and disposition attestation signing the class+reason on the manifest.
